function rowToEntry(row) {
    const entry = {
        id: row.id,
        key: row.key,
        value: row.value,
        tier: row.tier,
        ts: Number(row.ts),
    };
    if (row.valid_from)
        entry.validFrom = row.valid_from;
    if (row.valid_until)
        entry.validUntil = row.valid_until;
    if (row.superseded_by)
        entry.supersededBy = row.superseded_by;
    return entry;
}
